title: 2. Check conclusions one by one3. Do not assume anything extra

blocks.content:
Solved Example:

Statements:

All soldiers are disciplined.

Some disciplined are officers.



Conclusion:

Some soldiers are officers.

Logic:

Not necessarily true (no direct link)

Answer:

Conclusion does not follow

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Evaluate each conclusion individually against the provided statements.
Strictly avoid incorporating real-world facts or assumptions not explicitly given in the premises.
A conclusion is valid only if it logically and directly follows from the statements.
Exam questions frequently use real-world truths as options to trap candidates who rely on external knowledge.
Always test every conclusion one by one to ensure accuracy in statement-conclusion questions.
